name: Mr. Ashford (Careworn)
appearance: The same gentleman diminished — a coat gone shabby at the seams, a tired, anxious face, the polish of prosperity rubbed away.
definition: Mr. Ashford after misfortune: property lost or dwindled, the easy respectability now a struggle to keep up appearances. Careworn and proud, he clings to the manners of a station he can no longer afford.
voice: Guarded and strained, courtesy worn thin over worry; he deflects questions of circumstance with weary dignity.
